cautions.en: Pricing figures in this dossier come from third-party pricing trackers, not krea.ai/pricing directly, because the official domain could not be fetched in this session (bot-blocking behavior). Third-party sources also disagree on exact Max-plan pricing ($70 vs $105/month for different compute-unit configurations), suggesting Krea uses a configurable/tiered compute-unit selector rather than fixed plans above Pro. Treat all figures here as provisional until re-verified on the official page.

capabilities.en: Aggregates 60+ third-party and proprietary AI image/video generation models (e.g. Flux, Runway, Veo) in one unified interface with a shared compute-unit credit system.
Offers real-time AI art/image generation alongside standard asynchronous generation workflows.

limitations.en: Usage is metered via compute units shared across all models, so heavier or more expensive models consume the monthly allowance faster than others.
Plan structure above the Pro tier appears configurable rather than fixed, making it harder to compare a single flat price across tools.

reason.en: Direct AI image generation competitor and one of the model providers aggregated by Krea itself.
AI image/video generation platform competing directly for the same creative use cases.
AI image upscaling/enhancement tool with overlapping creative use cases.
